mLocKeys.keySummary: Every few basic attacks, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing extra damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every @HeadshotRequirement@ attacks (attacks while in brush count as 2), Caitlyn will fire a <keywordMajor>Headshot</keywordMajor>, dealing either <physicalDamage>@HeadShotTotalDamageTT@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to a champion or <physicalDamage>@HeadShotMinionTotalDamageTT@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to a minion.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Headshot: Ready</titleLeft><mainText>Caitlyn's next basic attack will deal either 150% damage to a champion or 250% damage to a minion.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Yordle Trap: Sight</titleLeft><mainText>Caitlyn can see this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Headshot: Count</titleLeft><mainText> Caitlyn is charging up for a headshot.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Caitlyn fires a net dealing <magicDamage>@NetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slows</status> the target by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ second(s). Knocks Caitlyn back.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Caitlyn revs her rifle for @CastTime@ second to fire a piercing shot dealing <physicalDamage>@InitialDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Deals @ExtraHitPercentReduction*100@% less damage to each subsequent target down to a minimum of @MinimumDamagePercent*100@%.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ace in the Hole: Targeted</titleLeft><mainText>You are about to be shot by Caitlyn.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Caitlyn takes a second to line up the perfect shot, firing a bullet at an enemy Champion dealing <physicalDamage>@RTotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> at @CastRange@ range. Other enemy Champions can intercept the bullet.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn sets a trap to find sneaky yordles. When sprung, the trap immobilizes the champion, reveals them and deals magic damage over a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Caitlyn sets a trap that an enemy Champion can spring <status>Rooting</status> them for a short duration and revealing them for @VisibilityDuration@ seconds. The trap deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @DOTTime@ seconds, and lasts for @Duration@ minutes. Only @MaxTraps@ traps may be active at once.
